name: Culling the Threat
summary: Astranaar fears an attack from the Thistlefur furbolgs gathering to the north. Raene Wolfrunner asks you to kill their chieftain, Dal Bloodclaw, before they strike.

sections.title: A Looming Peril to the North
sections.body: Astranaar lies in the heart of Ashenvale, with danger close on every side. The Thistlefur furbolgs live just north of town. Once peaceful forest dwellers, they have fallen to madness and aggression, as have many of their kin. Sentinel scouts have watched their numbers grow over recent months. Now they fear the tribe will attack Astranaar as one.

sections.title: Striking the Chieftain
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner calls on travelers to strike before the Thistlefur overrun Astranaar's palisades. Dal Bloodclaw leads the tribe and gives its members order and courage. The Sentinels ask you to bring his skull back to Astranaar. They hope his death will break the furbolgs' unity and buy the beleaguered town precious time.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Culling the Threat?
aliases: where do i get culling the threat
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner, a Sentinel commander in the night elf town of Astranaar, asks you to act.

faq.q: Why does Astranaar want Dal Bloodclaw dead?
faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw leads the Thistlefur tribe just north of Astranaar. Their numbers are growing quickly, and Raene Wolfrunner fears he will lead an attack unless his leadership is broken.

faq.q: Why are the Thistlefur furbolgs hostile to the night elves?
faq.answer: Furbolgs and night elves were once allies, but demonic and corrupting influences across Ashenvale have driven many tribes, including the Thistlefur, into violent frenzy and fear of outsiders.

faq.q: Where can Dal Bloodclaw be found?
faq.answer: Dal Bloodclaw can be found in Thistlefur Village and its nearby barrows, directly north of Astranaar in Ashenvale.

faq.q: Does killing Dal Bloodclaw solve the furbolg threat permanently?
faq.answer: No. Raene Wolfrunner says Dal Bloodclaw's death will curb the Thistlefur's aggression for a time. While corruption grips Ashenvale, the furbolg population remains a danger.

faq.q: What proof of Dal Bloodclaw's death is required?
aliases: culling the threat turn in item
faq.answer: Bring Dal Bloodclaw's Skull directly to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you face the sorrow of striking down ancient allies driven mad, while taking brutal measures to protect Astranaar from ruin.
You know Astranaar is vital to Alliance supply lines and communication across central Kalimdor. Danger north of town demands urgent action.
As a druid, you see the Thistlefur's madness with deep sorrow. Ashenvale's lingering taint drives noble furbolgs into bloodthirsty beasts.
